children: The number of homes available for sale in New York State increased nearly 10% in September, and the median sales price also saw a rise, the New York State Association of Realtors says. Across the state, housing inventory rose 9.8% in September from the year-ago period, to 35,294 homes. Median sale prices in the state rose to $450,000, from $425,000 in September of 2025. September saw closed sales drop by 1.4%, while pending sales were down 5.4% from the year-ago period, the Association says. (stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com)
